messages:
Sam B.: Hey team, AcmeLegal pinged me — they need a minimal SOC 2 control excerpt (controls for access mgmt + encryption), a simple network diagram for the POC, and a signed pen-test attestation. They want to close procurement this week. @Alex P. @Maria K. any blockers?
Alex P.: We can provide redacted SOC2 excerpts and a one-page network diagram. Question: do they require a named vendor pen-test report or is a signed attestation letter from our security team enough?
Maria K.: For most POCs a signed pen-test attestation letter + statement of scope works. If they're asking for raw report we need legal OK. Also, will this be for Hosted API or Dedicated? That changes the network diagram details.
Sam B.: Good point — it's for Hosted API (public endpoints) but they want to see staging IP allowlist for the demo. Also asked whether KMS keys are customer-managed in POC (they're not).
Alex P.: Okay — I'll assemble: redacted SOC2 excerpt (access mgmt, logging, change control), network diagram annotated for Hosted POC, and pen-test attestation template signed by SecOps. ETA: EOD Thursday if nothing else.
Maria K.: I can sign the attestation once SecOps okays. Need SecOps to confirm the pen-test scope sentence: "No external, production-impacting testing performed; attestation based on internal controls review and previous third-party pentest (redacted)." Thoughts?
Sam B.: That wording sounds fine. Can we add a short note about data residency: "no customer data persisted in EU unless customer opts into region" — Acme cares about that.
Alex P.: Will add that line. For the staging IPs — we can give a CIDR range and presigned S3 link for the diagram + excerpts. Example presign command for the docs bucket:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/acme-poc/3831234567/soc2-excerpt.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
Maria K.: Perfect. Sam — can you confirm if AcmeLegal will accept an attestation signed by Security Director (Maria K.) or require CISO?
Sam B.: They said "authorized security signatory" is fine. Maria you're set. I'll send the request and ask them to confirm acceptance.
evidence-bot: Evidence bundle created: https://evidence.redwood.com/bundles/3831234567 (contains SOC2-excerpt.pdf, network-diagram.png, pen-test-attestation-template.pdf).
Alex P.: One more: pricing note — if they ask about Dedicated pricing during procurement, flag to sales ops. POC won't change pricing but Dedicated sizing could.
Maria K.: I'll sign and route to SecOps for a quick stamp. If SecOps pushes back I'll escalate.
Sam B.: Thanks all — I'll follow up with AcmeLegal and post the final signed attestation here. :thumbsup:
